correctness.rationale: The sole reciprocal pair and 2(n-1)-arc budget force each later vertex in a single-core order to receive exactly one inbound and one outbound arc from distinct earlier agents. Degree (1,1) is equivalent to removability, and any set of such agents is pairwise nonadjacent and may be deleted jointly. For a fixed r-set, deleting yields F_(n-r)*((n-r)(n-r-1))^r possibilities. Inclusion-exclusion gives F_n and binomial inversion gives R_(n,k); every valid graph has at least one removable agent, and the all-terminal boundary is 2^(n-2). Independent graph-generation by all attachment orders exactly recovered n=3..6 histograms (2); (16,4); (312,192,8); (11520,12192,1664,16), totals 2,20,512,25392. This proof is conditional on Sugiura’s published single-core equivalence; its full text was not accessible this run, so external source theorem remains an explicit premise.
